Canada wins silver in wheelchair basketball world championship final

Canada secured the silver medal in the women's wheelchair basketball world championship after losing to the United States in the final. The championship was held in Ottawa. The final score was 77-76 in favor of the U.S. Players also commented on the accessibility of Ottawa.
